newsitem.title: USA: American Restaurant cuts unit payout.
newsitem.headline: American Restaurant cuts unit payout.

text.p: Amercian Restaurant Partners LP, which owns Pizza Hut franshises, said Wednesday it has reduced its quarterly cash distribution to its Class A Income Preference Unit holders to $0.05 a unit from the $0.06 a unit paid in January and April.
"Our operating results continue to suffer primarily due to sales declines and the increase in minimum wage," Hal McCoy, chairman and managing general partner, said in a news release.
McCoy said same-store sales have declined for five months in a row.

"As a result the partnership has fallen short of generating sufficient cash flow from operations to fund capital expenditures for recurring replacement of equipment in existing restaurants, to service debt obligations and to make a quarterly cash distribution at a quarterly rate of $0.11 per unit," he said.
American Restaurant shares were down 1/4 at 4-3/4 Wednesday.
